title: A newborn miner a run left loaded docks at Confederacy Central Command, Sol and stores its hold
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 03:19 UTC (orders ENT-071, P6 and O1; rule F8). At 03:18 UTC newborn miners waited with 5 to 41 units aboard (iron, copper, starter goods): every gather of their rows asks an empty hold (fill.py status miner: hold not empty). The same work as store-hold-central-nexus for the Solarian-born rows, at their capital's station; requires.empire solarian keeps every other pilot off it. 2026-11-23 08:49 UTC (Zero): max_ships 20 -> 35, every row of its empire, so a loaded newborn always finds its own store and never falls through to store-hold-central-nexus (20 jumps away). 2026-11-23 11:34 UTC (Zero): requires.max_jumps 10: a Solarian ship gone 10 or more jumps out (Hamal, Schedar, Synchrony at about 11:33 UTC, fleet.json) stores at Central Nexus by its template instead of a long flight home with a hold (P1; errors.log ENT-154).
